spans.s: प्रु vt. 1Ā (pres. प्रवते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to jump.
प्रुष् (I) vt. 1P (pp. पृष्ट; pres. प्रोषति) To burn, to reduce to ashes.
प्रुष् (II) vt. or vi. 9P (pres. पृष्णाति) 1. To become wet, to become moist; 2. to sprinkle; 3. to fill.
प्रुष्व m. 1. The rainy season; 2. the sun; 3. a drop of water.
